status: Exploratory research on known periods, not fresh validation
displacement: Breakout candle directional body >= 0.5 current ATR, close in directional outer 25% of its range, and close at least 0.1 ATR beyond previously confirmed broken swing
fresh_origin: Most recent confirmed opposite pivot must be between 1 and 40 chart bars old at breakout
application: Evaluate only on the first closed breakout cross while flat/idle. Rejecting a weak cross does not consume its swing identifier; it may qualify only on a later genuine recross. No late confirmation above an already-broken level.
unchanged: Confirmed pivots, prior closed 4h trend, first 50-61.8 pullback, two-candle rejection, rejection-break stop entry, 1.5 modeled net R, 0.25% risk, 95% notional, maximum 1 BTC, fixed stop/target, modeled 0.07% fee/reserve and actual funding
periods: Same seven previously inspected 2024 H1/H2, 2025 H1/H2, 2026 Q1/Q2/Q3 independent-account periods
policy: No threshold grid or tuning after results. Report all candidates. No default promotion or independent profitability claim without a new unused validation period.
